note: Every program in tests/ and scripts/ that stands in for a CLI is found by tests/helpers/stand-ins.cjs and checked by tests/fake-cli-contract.test.cjs.

contract.version: Every stand-in answers --version at once, with nothing written to its folder (Claude: '<n.n.n> (Claude Code)'; Codex: 'codex-cli <n.n.n>').
contract.echo: With AGENTRIX_STAND_IN_ECHO naming a file, a node stand-in writes there the arguments it was given, the --settings it was given and the hooks in them (tests/fixtures/stand-in-echo.cjs).
contract.appServer: A stand-in that answers thread/start answers the sandbox and approvals it was asked for, as Codex does.

deliberate.SYNTHETIC_CODEX_MODE=windows-sandbox: answers read-only until the request carries the unelevated Windows sandbox, for the retry tests
deliberate.SYNTHETIC_CODEX_MODE=sandbox-persist: keeps the sandbox of an earlier start for a resume that asks none, for the stored-policy test

tests/fixtures/codex-app-server-env.cjs.note: A Claude Code print-mode stand-in (it reads the prompt from its input), named for the folder it began in.

tests/fixtures/codex-app-server-scope.cj.note: A Claude Code print-mode stand-in that edits files for the dispatch scope tests.

tests/fixtures/multi-codex.cs.note: Compiled program: it answers --version and has no echo.

tests/fixtures/argv-recorder.cs.note: Not a CLI: it appends the exact arguments it was started with to ARGV_RECORDER_FILE and exits 7, which is its whole echo.

tests/fixtures/dispatch-worker.cjs.note: Stands in for either CLI in the dispatch tests; a version probe is answered before any fixture is read.

tests/fixtures/restore-codex.cs.note: Compiled program: it answers --version and -V before anything else and has no echo.

notStandIns.tests/fixtures/claude-sdk.cjs: an in-process fake of the Agent SDK's query(), not a program the product starts
notStandIns.tests/fixtures/claude-sdk-launcher.cjs: C# source of a launcher that forwards every argument, --version and --settings included, to AGENTRIX_FAKE_CLI, which is claude-sdk-cli.cjs
